mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings from 2024 production: the thrust main is said to slip onto the cap and block side groove too easily instead of being an interference fit, raising a spun-thrust-bearing risk. The poster reports King's technical team confirmed the 2024 main bearings were out of spec and recommended returning them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.
